scope: One source per static opaque authored family, six perspective targets at 512 x 512. The model predicts thresholded display-sRGB reconstruction error.

R1.resample: 2 by 2 nonoverlapping box mean of original 8-bit display-sRGB samples; ties to nearest even uint8; no crop or padding
R1.camera: multiply boundary-origin source K first two rows by 0.5, then convert back to integer-centre K; keep poses and target cameras
R1.source_features: exact R1 source and the R1-sized self-render

Q1.transform: little-endian binary32 to IEEE binary16 nearest ties to even and back to binary32; preserve order, geometry, opacity, header and metadata bytes
Q1.invalid: fail on nonfinite input colour coefficients or FP16 overflow; retain failure

predictions_before_formal_acquisition.question: What happens to error in surfaces newly exposed at a target?
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.expectation: Mean B0 thresholded RGB error incidence is greater in physically disoccluded areas than in observed areas.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.reason: Those surfaces lack a corresponding colour observation from the input camera.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.falsifier: Family-equal incidence for disoccluded pixels is less than or equal to that of observed pixels; state empty partitions.

predictions_before_formal_acquisition.question: Can the learned predictor localize high RGB error on held-out B0 layouts?
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.expectation: L1-full improves family-equal AP over the constant prior; its advantage over L0 and 1-alpha is uncertain.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.reason: Some correspondence, motion, colour and local depth features may predict where synthesis changes.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.confidence: moderate for constant comparison; low for other baselines
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.falsifier: Equal or lower held-out common-mask AP; report individual families, class composition and coverage.

predictions_before_formal_acquisition.question: What does half-size R1 input change?
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.expectation: R1 may increase small-detail RGB errors while the fixed internal network resolution limits forward-time savings.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.reason: External downsampling discards detail before SHARP resizes to its fixed network input.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.confidence: moderate on detail, low on time
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.falsifier: No increase in measured error or a consistent measured speed-up across repeats.

predictions_before_formal_acquisition.question: How does single-pass FP16 colour rounding affect Q1?
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.expectation: Pure geometry features and eligibility should stay equal for unchanged geometry when the renderer is deterministic. RGB and full model scores may change slightly, with no guaranteed performance loss.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.reason: Only stored degree-zero colour coefficients change.
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.confidence: high on input invariance; low on measurable image or ranking change
predictions_before_formal_acquisition.falsifier: Geometry field digests differ, or verified geometry-only features/scores change beyond recorded tolerances; report genuine zero change.

model_selection.sample: first 16 bytes SHA-256 interpreted unsigned big-endian of UTF-8 9184 LF catalog_sha256 LF family_id LF camera_id with no trailing LF; NumPy PCG64 uniform without replacement, row-major flat indices saved
model_selection.fallback: sorted training family IDs modulo 3 or 2
model_selection.weight: N/(F * nonempty_views_in_family * samples_in_view), recomputed per fit
model_selection.method: view AP on two-class validation views; mean within family, then equal among families; ties within 1e-6 take smaller C
model_selection.constant: incidence on complete training E, pooled within family then equal across families

development_threshold.ties: complete score groups; ties in distance to 0.8 choose lower attainable coverage; include accept-none/accept-all-scoreable endpoints
development_threshold.aggregation: pool V and low counts within family, equal weight among families

evaluation.ranking: identical per-view scoreable intersection across all five methods, two-class views only; whole ties; view then family equal
evaluation.primary_examples: v01 for every test family and condition; retain all six views
evaluation.calibration: risk scores, descriptive reliability bins optional; no claim of calibrated probabilities

timing_repeats.warmup: selected formal execution serves as warm-up; retain identical stage config, vary run ID; report stage/process timings and first compilation separately

failure_rule: Preserve every attempt. Use the first integrity- and interface-complete scientific chain, independently of observed error. A code or scientific configuration change is versioned. Timing and transfer retries are separately identified.
